keyTakeaways: In 2026 Swarna Gowri Vratha and Ganesh Chaturthi both fall on Monday 14 September for Bengaluru — Gowri puja 06:09-07:06 AM, Ganesha puja 11:02 AM-01:28 PM per Drik Panchang.

faqs.question: What does ಶುಭಾಶಯಗಳು actually mean?
faqs.answer: It means "greetings" or "good wishes" — shubhashayagalu, from the Sanskrit shubha (auspicious) and ashaya (intent), with the Kannada plural -galu. It belongs to the written register, so it reads correctly on a card or a message but almost nobody says it aloud at home.

faqs.question: Is Ganesha called Ganesha, Ganapati or Benaka in Kannada?
faqs.answer: All three are correct and they are not interchangeable in tone. ಗಣೇಶ and ಗಣಪತಿ are the Sanskrit-derived names used in formal wishes, while ಬೆನಕ is the older Kannada tadbhava of Vinayaka recorded in Kittel's 1894 dictionary and now mostly heard in villages and place names.

faqs.question: Do people in Karnataka say "Ganpati Bappa Morya"?
faqs.answer: It is a Marathi chant that has spread across India through films and Mumbai visarjan footage, and you will hear it at public pandals in Bengaluru. In a Kannada household message it reads as borrowed; ಗಣೇಶ ಚತುರ್ಥಿಯ ಶುಭಾಶಯಗಳು is the local equivalent.

faqs.question: What is a bagina and who receives one?
faqs.answer: A bagina is the tray of turmeric, kumkum, bangles, rice, coconut and a blouse piece that married women exchange on Gowri Habba. Kittel's Kannada-English Dictionary defines ಬಾಗಿನ as "a present made by a lady whose husband is living", which is why the exchange is between married women.

faqs.question: Is kadubu the same thing as a modak?
faqs.answer: They are cousins, not the same dish. Kadubu is the Karnataka steamed rice dumpling offered to Ganesha, filled with coconut and jaggery, and the word is attested in classical Kannada texts. Writing modak in a Kannada wish usually means the line was translated from Marathi or Hindi.

faqs.question: My cousin speaks Kannada but cannot read the script — what should I send?
faqs.answer: Send the Kannada script line and the Roman transliteration together on two lines. In the CoLI-Kenglish corpus of Kannada YouTube comments, 32.32% of tagged words were already English and only 44.8% were Kannada, so reading Kannada in Roman letters is completely normal online.

faqs.question: Will the Kannada script show up as empty boxes on the recipient's phone?
faqs.answer: Not on a current Android or iPhone — both ship Kannada fonts by default. Boxes usually appear on old devices, on some desktop browsers with restricted font sets, or inside an image that was rendered with a font missing the ottakshara conjuncts.

faqs.question: How do I type Kannada on an Android phone or an iPhone?
faqs.answer: Add Kannada as a keyboard language in system settings; both Gboard and the iOS Kannada keyboard offer a transliteration mode. You type shubhashayagalu in Roman letters and the engine assembles ಶುಭಾಶಯಗಳು, which is how most people write the script on a phone.

faqs.question: What is the difference between ಶುಭಾಶಯಗಳು and ಶುಭಕಾಮನೆಗಳು?
faqs.answer: ಶುಭಾಶಯಗಳು is the standard Kannada word for greetings. ಶುಭಕಾಮನೆಗಳು is the Hindi shubhkamnayen respelt in Kannada letters, and Kannada readers clock it as a translated message rather than one written in Kannada.

faqs.question: How many days do people in Karnataka keep the Ganesha idol at home?
faqs.answer: Households usually immerse on day one, three or five rather than running the full ten days, which are more a Maharashtra public-mandal pattern. The outer limit in 2026 is Anant Chaturdashi, Friday 25 September, when the last idols go into the water.

faqs.question: Can I use the same wish for Gauri Habba and for Ganesh Chaturthi?
faqs.answer: In 2026 you can, because Drik Panchang puts both on Monday 14 September for Bengaluru. A wish naming ಗೌರಿ ಗಣೇಶ ಹಬ್ಬ covers the whole festival; if you want to mark the Gowri puja separately, send that line before 07:06 AM when the Pratahkala muhurat closes.

article.contentMarkdown:
# Ganesh Chaturthi Wishes in Kannada for Gowri-Ganesha Habba

Ganesh Chaturthi wishes in Kannada are usually sent as ಗಣೇಶ ಚತುರ್ಥಿಯ ಹಾರ್ದಿಕ ಶುಭಾಶಯಗಳು — *Ganesha Chaturthiya hardika shubhashayagalu*, "heartfelt Ganesha Chaturthi greetings". In Karnataka the more accurate wish names both deities, because the state keeps the two days as one festival: Gowri-Ganesha Habba. In 2026 they collapse into a single Monday. Drik Panchang puts Swarna Gowri Vratha and Ganesh Chaturthi both on **14 September 2026** for Bengaluru, Gowri puja at dawn and Ganesha puja at midday, with visarjan on Friday 25 September. Below are eight wishes in the Kannada script, each with Roman transliteration and a literal English meaning. Two numbers to place the format question, both measured platform-wide across all 15 SubhSandesh page types rather than for Ganesh pages specifically: 49.6% of 45,656 recorded page views open on a phone, and 96.1% of the 3,860 pages started since March 2026 were published and shared.

## Why Karnataka calls it Gowri-Ganesha Habba

Karnataka does not celebrate Ganesha alone. [Akashvani's Karnataka bulletin](https://www.newsonair.gov.in/gowri-ganesha-festival-is-being-celebrated-with-devotion-all-over-karnataka) describes the festival as "Gowri-Ganesha", with the Gowri idol installed in the mandapam, worship offered, and gifts distributed among the women of the house.

Those gifts have a name. [Kittel's Kannada-English Dictionary](https://dsal.uchicago.edu/cgi-bin/app/kittel_query.py?qs=b%C4%81gina&searchhws=yes) defines ಬಾಗಿನ (*bagina*) as a tadbhava of Sanskrit *vayana*, "a present made by a lady whose husband is living" — the tray of turmeric, kumkum, bangles, rice and coconut that married women exchange on Gowri Habba.

The order matters. Gowri arrives at her parents' house first; Ganesha comes to take her home, which is why the Karnataka wish is addressed to both.

2026 breaks the usual one-day gap. For Bengaluru, Drik Panchang gives the [Pratahkala Gowri muhurat](https://www.drikpanchang.com/festivals/gowri-habba/swarna-gowri-vratha-date.html?geoname-id=1277333&year=2026) as 06:09 AM to 07:06 AM on Monday 14 September and the [Madhyahna Ganesha muhurat](https://www.drikpanchang.com/festivals/ganesh-chaturthi/ganesh-chaturthi-date-time.html?geoname-id=1277333&year=2026) as 11:02 AM to 01:28 PM the same Monday. A wish sent at 9 PM misses both.

## Eight Ganesh Chaturthi wishes in Kannada, with transliteration and meaning

Each line gives the Kannada script, the Roman transliteration you can paste when the script will not render, and a literal meaning rather than a loose one.

### 1. The standard formal wish

ಸರ್ವರಿಗೂ ಗಣೇಶ ಚತುರ್ಥಿಯ ಹಾರ್ದಿಕ ಶುಭಾಶಯಗಳು.

*Sarvarigu Ganesha Chaturthiya hardika shubhashayagalu.*

Literally: "Heartfelt Ganesha Chaturthi greetings to everyone." *Hardika* is a Sanskrit loan meaning "of the heart". Use it for a WhatsApp group, an office broadcast or an apartment association message.

### 2. The one that names Gowri first

ಗೌರಿ ಗಣೇಶ ಹಬ್ಬದ ಶುಭಾಶಯಗಳು. ನಿಮ್ಮ ಮನೆಗೆ ಸುಖ, ಶಾಂತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಸಮೃದ್ಧಿ ಬರಲಿ.

*Gowri Ganesha habbada shubhashayagalu. Nimma manege sukha, shanti mattu samruddhi barali.*

Literally: "Greetings of the Gowri-Ganesha festival. May comfort, peace and prosperity come to your home." This is the wish that marks you out as writing from Karnataka rather than copying a Mumbai template. Send it on the morning of 14 September 2026.

### 3. For the women of the house, on Gowri Habba

ಗೌರಿ ದೇವಿ ನಿಮಗೆ ಸೌಭಾಗ್ಯ ಮತ್ತು ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ಕರುಣಿಸಲಿ. ಗೌರಿ ಹಬ್ಬದ ಶುಭಾಶಯಗಳು.

*Gowri devi nimage saubhagya mattu arogya karunisali. Gowri habbada shubhashayagalu.*

Literally: "May Goddess Gowri grant you saubhagya and health. Greetings of Gowri Habba." Send it before 07:06 AM on 14 September 2026, while the Pratahkala muhurat is still open and the bagina is being handed over.

### 4. For someone who is stuck

ವಿಘ್ನನಿವಾರಕ ಗಣಪತಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ವಿಘ್ನಗಳನ್ನು ದೂರ ಮಾಡಲಿ.

*Vighnanivaraka Ganapati nimma ella vighnagalannu dura madali.*

Literally: "May Ganapati, the remover of obstacles, take all your obstacles far away." *Vighna* means obstacle in a specific sense — the thing blocking a project, an exam result, a house registration. Good for a colleague or a student, poor for a bereavement.

### 5. Benaka, the old Kannada name

ಬೆನಕನ ಆಶೀರ್ವಾದ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಮನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸದಾ ಇರಲಿ.

*Benakana ashirvada nimma maneyalli sada irali.*

Literally: "May Benaka's blessing always be in your home." Kittel records [ಬೆನಕ as the Kannada tadbhava of ವಿನಾಯಕ](https://dsal.uchicago.edu/cgi-bin/app/kittel_query.py?qs=benaka&searchhws=yes), Vinayaka — a form still alive in place names like Benakanahalli.

### 6. Kadubu, not modak

ಕಡುಬು ಸಿಹಿಯಾಗಿರಲಿ, ವರ್ಷ ಇನ್ನೂ ಸಿಹಿಯಾಗಿರಲಿ.

*Kadubu sihiyagirali, varsha innu sihiyagirali.*

Literally: "May the kadubu be sweet, and the year sweeter still." ಕಡುಬು is the steamed offering in most Kannada households — Kittel lists it as a food word attested in classical Kannada texts. Writing *modak* in a Kannada wish is the tell of a translated template.

### 7. For someone who has had a hard year

ಈ ಗಣೇಶ ಚತುರ್ಥಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕಷ್ಟಗಳಿಗೆ ಕೊನೆ ಹಾಡಲಿ, ಹೊಸ ಆರಂಭ ತರಲಿ.

*I Ganesha Chaturthi nimma kashtagalige kone hadali, hosa arambha tarali.*

Literally: "May this Ganesha Chaturthi sing an end to your troubles and bring a new beginning." *Kone hadu* is a genuine Kannada idiom for finishing something off, not a Hindi calque. Use it where a prosperity wish would land badly.

### 8. Spoken Kannada, for a friend

ಹಬ್ಬ ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ಆಚರಿಸಿ! ಗಣಪ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಜೊತೆ ಇರಲಿ.

*Habba chennagi acharisi! Ganapa nimma jote irali.*

Literally: "Celebrate the festival well! May Ganapa be with you." ಗಣಪ rather than ಗಣಪತಿ, ಜೊತೆ rather than ಜೊತೆಯಲ್ಲಿ — this is how the wish is actually spoken in Bengaluru and Mysuru, and it reads as a person rather than a forward.

## Kannada script or Roman letters: what Kannada comment data shows

The choice is not stylistic. Shashirekha and colleagues built the [CoLI-Kenglish dataset](https://acta.uni-obuda.hu/Lakshmaiah_Balouchzahi_Anusha_Sidorov_128.pdf) by downloading 100,000 comments from 373 Kannada YouTube videos and hand-tagging 19,432 unique words. Of those, 44.8% were Kannada, 32.32% were English, and 7.5% were Kannada-English hybrids like *dogsgalige*, an English noun carrying a Kannada suffix.

The same paper is blunt about why: keyboards default to Roman script, and despite Indic input apps, most users still type their local language in Roman letters.

So the Kannada script is the minority format even among Kannada speakers online. It is still right for a greeting — a festival wish is the one message people expect in the script — but pair it with the transliteration when you are not sure the recipient reads Kannada fluently.

## Why the Kannada script is heavy on a phone keyboard

Kannada is not a 26-key alphabet. Hebbi and Mamatha, [building a handwritten-character dataset](https://doi.org/10.47852/bonviewAIA3202624) from 500 writers, count 34 *vyanjanagalu* (consonants), 13 *swaragalu* (vowels) and 2 *yogavahagalu* in the base set.

Combining those consonants with the vowels produces 510 *kagunitas*. Add the *ottaksharas* — subscript consonant clusters written below the line — and the digits, and the paper puts the full class count above 600 distinct shapes. Their dataset runs to 130,981 samples across 85 classes.

That is why Kannada keyboards on Android and iOS are transliteration engines rather than key-per-letter layouts: you type *shubhashayagalu* and the engine assembles ಶುಭಾಶಯಗಳು. It also explains the broken conjunct you sometimes see in a forwarded image, where an old font renders an ottakshara as a box.

## Written Kannada is not spoken Kannada

ಶುಭಾಶಯಗಳು is a Sanskrit-derived word that almost nobody says out loud in a Kannada kitchen. The written register of Kannada and the spoken register have drifted far apart, and greetings sit squarely in the written one — which is exactly why a copied wish can feel stiff.

You can hear the gap in the eighth wish above. ಗಣಪ against ಗಣಪತಿ, ಜೊತೆ against ಜೊತೆಯಲ್ಲಿ, ಆಚರಿಸಿ against ಆಚರಿಸಿರಿ: same message, two registers, and the choice signals how close you are to the person.

Pick the register deliberately: formal ಹಾರ್ದಿಕ ಶುಭಾಶಯಗಳು to an elder, a boss or a group; the spoken form to a cousin. Kittel's dictionary of 1894 is still the fastest way to check whether a word you found online is genuine Kannada or a Hindi import in Kannada spelling.

## Four ways to send a Kannada wish, compared

The format decides whether the Kannada survives as text or turns into pixels.

| How you send it | Kannada stays selectable text | Prep time | What SubhSandesh's own numbers say (platform-wide, all 15 page types) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Kannada script typed into WhatsApp | Yes | Under a minute | Nothing — WhatsApp is not visible to us |
| Roman transliteration in WhatsApp | Yes | Under a minute | Nothing — WhatsApp is not visible to us |
| A forwarded JPEG of the wish | No, it is pixels | Seconds | Nothing — the image leaves the platform |
| A personalised page sent as a link | Yes | 5–10 minutes | 49.6% of 45,656 views open on a phone; 42.1% of 3,860 pages are password-protected; 96.1% get published |

Avoid the forwarded JPEG. Kannada inside an image cannot be searched, copied, translated or read aloud by a screen reader, and the ottaksharas are the first thing to break when it is recompressed.

For the last row done properly, the [Ganesh Chaturthi page the recipient performs themselves](https://subhsandesh.in/happy-ganesh-chaturthi) is the one built for this: they offer the durva, kumkum, flowers and modak, the aarti thali circles while Karpur Gauram plays, and they write their own prarthana back. You can put the Kannada line in as the message and add your own mandap photo.

## When a Kannada wishes page is the wrong thing to send

A page cannot hand anyone a kadubu, and it cannot stand in the queue at the Ganapati temple on Bull Temple Road for you. If you are in the same city as the person, go.

It is also the wrong format for a grandparent without a smartphone. Platform-wide, 49.6% of SubhSandesh's 45,656 recorded views arrive on a phone and 49.9% on a touch device of some kind, so a recipient who only has a shared desktop is a poor fit for anything animated.

The 42.1% of creators who password-protect a page before sharing it — 1,625 of 3,860, again platform-wide rather than Ganesh-specific — are adding a step. For an 84-year-old aunt in Hubballi, that step is the reason she never opens it. Send her plain Kannada text and keep the page for the cousins' group; the [full template gallery](https://subhsandesh.in/templates) is worth a look only once you know the recipient will tap a link.

If the aim is a keepsake the family reopens after the visarjan on 25 September 2026, the page wins. If it is a greeting read once at 7 AM, plain text wins.

## Watch the page get built

Ninety seconds, start to finish — the aarti going round, the five offerings, and the box at the end where they write a line back to you: [Ganesh Chaturthi Wishes Online — Full Walkthrough](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mpWiv5T59QY). More page walkthroughs on Instagram: [@subhsandesh_official](https://www.instagram.com/subhsandesh_official).

- Drik Panchang, [Ganesh Chaturthi 2026, Bengaluru](https://www.drikpanchang.com/festivals/ganesh-chaturthi/ganesh-chaturthi-date-time.html?geoname-id=1277333&year=2026) — 14 September 2026, muhurat 11:02 AM to 01:28 PM.

failed.why: The eight wish blocks deliberately break the rule: the Kannada line, the Roman transliteration and the literal gloss each sit as their own paragraph, so three of every four paragraphs in that section are a single line. Fixable only by merging script and transliteration onto one line, which would make both harder to copy on a phone — the tradeoff was taken knowingly. Everything outside the wish list runs 2–3 sentences.

failed.item: At least one table column uses first-party data
failed.why: The fourth column is first-party but only one of its four cells carries a number — the other three honestly read "Nothing — WhatsApp is not visible to us", because SubhSandesh has no telemetry on messages sent outside the platform. It would close if the comparison were rewritten to compare page types against each other, but that is not the comparison a reader of this keyword needs.

failed.why: Both internal links are verbatim from TEMPLATE_LINKS in app/lib/prompt.ts, but https://subhsandesh.in/happy-ganesh-chaturthi returned HTTP 404 in production on 2026-09-09 while /templates returned 200. Structural for this pass — the link is correct and the template is unpublished. It closes the moment the Ganesh template is deployed or made visible in /admin/templates; re-check before the batch is published, because it is the primary CTA in all ten posts.

auditReport.honestAssessment: An answer engine would cite this over the five pages analysed because it is the only one of them that gets the regional frame right — Gowri-Ganesha Habba, the bagina, kadubu rather than modak, ಬೆನಕ out of Kittel — and the only one that pairs every Kannada line with a transliteration and a literal gloss instead of dumping script. The 2026 collision of Swarna Gowri Vratha and Ganesh Chaturthi on Monday 14 September, with both Bengaluru muhurats, appears on none of them, and the kagunita and CoLI-Kenglish counts are numbers no wishes farm carries. Two honest gaps. First, no open-access peer-reviewed study specific to Kannada diglossia was findable — searched "Kannada diglossia", "Kannada diglossia spoken written variety" and "Kannada sociolinguistic" on OpenAlex, DOAJ and Semantic Scholar; the IDEALS thesis on Kannada-English code-switching (hdl 2142/78494) is the obvious candidate and returns 403 — so the register section leans on Kittel and on the CoLI corpus rather than on diglossia scholarship. Second, there is no Ganesh-specific first-party data at all: every SubhSandesh number here is platform-wide across 15 page types and captioned that way, which is honest but weaker than a segment figure. What it cannot overcome: subhsandesh.in has far less authority in this Kannada SERP than Asianet Suvarna or Boldsky, both established Kannada news domains, and the query spikes for about a week a year. The primary CTA, /happy-ganesh-chaturthi, was still returning 404 in production on 2026-09-09.
